Packing list - cabin

sleeping bag, headlamp, camping stove (borrowed from Dana), coffee press

food: oatmeal, chili, s'mores stuff

Gift ideas

Grandpa: audiobook subscription, warm slippers size 11

Mom: ceramic planter, the lavender candle she liked at the market

Dentist notes

Use prescription toothpaste Clinpro 5000 twice daily

Car

Oil change every 5,000 miles. Last done at 48,200 miles on Aug 18 at Jiffy Lube on Sandy Blvd

Tire pressure 35 psi front and rear

Meeting with Priya - Q4 planning

Priorities: launch the client portal, hire one contractor, cut cloud spend 15%

Action: I own the vendor comparison by Oct 30

Sourdough recipe

500g bread flour, 350g water, 100g starter, 10g salt

Bulk ferment 5 hours, cold proof overnight, bake at 250C covered 20 min then 20 min uncovered

Books to read

The Overstory - Richard Powers

Piranesi - Susanna Clarke

The Ministry for the Future - Kim Stanley Robinson

Bike fit

Saddle height 74.5 cm, stem 90 mm, bars 42 cm

Bathroom fan rattles

Ask landlord about the lease renewal before Nov 1

Running plan

Long run Sundays, build to 10 miles by November

Tuesday and Thursday easy 4 miles
